newsitem.title: USA: Buffton sees Q3 oper loss from site costs.
newsitem.headline: Buffton sees Q3 oper loss from site costs.

text.p: Buffton Corp said on Monday that it expects to report a "substantial loss from continuing operations during the third quarter ending June 30, 1997, before it posts a pretax gain from the sale of a unit.
The sale of Current Technology Inc to Danaher Corp for $25,500,000 is scheduled to close early this week and will result in a pre-tax gain of $12.5 million, or $1.62 a share, Buffton said.
The company's third quarter operating loss will stem from expenses related to its Superfund stie in Vestal, N.Y. and a reserve for a note receivable from Depot Inc.
Buffton said the gain will be reported as a discontinued operation in its financial statements.
In addition we will expense costs related to the acquisition of Hotels of Distinction Inc and certain concept development costs, Buffton said.
Also, Buffton said third quarter results from continuing operations will be hurt by litigation expenses.
Buffton reported a profit of $0.05 a share, or $338,000, on revenues of $6.87 million in last year's third quarter.
